title: Send the gradient back through a residual block
brief: Write the ReLU mask, the branch's share of the input gradient, and the full backward pass of a residual block, and check all of it against finite differences.
hints: relu_mask(h) is (h > 0).astype(float). A unit at exactly 0 is off.
The branch share is dh1 @ W1, where dh1 = (dY @ W2) * relu_mask(h1). It does not include dY.
The shortcut hands dY straight to dx, so dx = dY + branch_gradient(dY, cache). Add the branch term on top of dY, not instead of it.
Each weight gradient is the upstream gradient, transposed, times that layer's input: dW2 = dY.T @ a1 and dW1 = dh1.T @ x. Each bias gradient sums over axis 0.
